Alex Winter on Instagram: "Find a #NoKings march in your community, on March 28th, at the link at @indivisibleteam or go directly to nokings.org
#nokings"
content.text: Bravo, Alex, for putting your shoulder to this wheel.How do I find a spot near meThanks for always standing up for what’s right Alex ✊🏽Be excellent to each other and party on, dudes! 👏💖🤘Thank you, Alex!🌬♥️ Thanks for speaking up, Alex. I'm marching in Champaign, IL. !YES, Alex!! Thank you so much for always speaking out for good! We’ll be there!! #nokingsBom dia meu amigo Deus te abençoe sempre eu amo u seu amigo keanu reeves meu grande amor lindo ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️eu não quero u dinheiro dele eu só quero u seu amorYes Alex! You're so right! Thank you for standing up and speaking out! ❤️❤️Wow… this truly feels like a breath of fresh air. In times that feel so heavy and uncertain, seeing people with a platform choose to speak up for human rights means more than words can express. It takes courage to stand up, especially in such a delicate and divided moment in our country. Thank you for using your voice, for showing compassion, and for reminding so many of us that humanity, rights and dignity should always come first. It gives hope when it’s needed the most. 🙏🏻❤️☮️Excellent. I hadn't heard about another march until seeing this. I'll be there.👏👏👏🔥March 28th! We need 10 million out this time. We can do it!Good luck every one of you.Yes,it belongs to you all.Be strong and you gone make it.Respect.🙏🏼👌👏❤️🥰🇧🇻
